questions.stem: What is the formula for the area of a square?
questions.solution: The correct formula for the area of a square is side × side. The other options are incorrect because they use the formula for the perimeter of a rectangle, the perimeter of a square, or an incorrect formula.

questions.stem: A rectangle has a length of 10 cm and a width of 5 cm. What is its perimeter?
questions.solution: The perimeter of a rectangle is calculated as 2 × (length + width). For a rectangle with a length of 10 cm and width of 5 cm, the perimeter is 2 × (10 + 5) = 30 cm. The other options are incorrect because they do not use the correct formula or make calculation errors.

hi.stem: एक आयत की लंबाई 10 सेमी और चौड़ाई 5 सेमी है। इसका परिमाप क्या है?
hi.solution: आयत का परिमाप 2 × (लंबाई + चौड़ाई) के रूप में गणना किया जाता है। 10 सेमी लंबाई और 5 सेमी चौड़ाई वाले आयत के लिए, परिमाप 2 × (10 + 5) = 30 सेमी है। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे सही सूत्र का उपयोग नहीं करते हैं या गणना त्रुटियां करते हैं।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses standard mathematical terminology.

mr.solution: एका आयताची फेरी 2 × (लांबी + रुंदी) असे गणित केले जाते. 10 सेमी लांबी आणि 5 सेमी रुंदी असलेल्या आयताची फेरी 2 × (10 + 5) = 30 सेमी असेल. इतर विकल्प चुकीच्या सूत्राचा वापर किंवा गणना चूकीमुळे चुकीले आहेत.

questions.stem: What is the area of a rectangle with length 5 m and width 10 m?
questions.solution: The area of a rectangle is calculated by multiplying its length and width. So, 5 m × 10 m = 50 sq. m. The other options are incorrect because they either add the values instead of multiplying or use one of the values as the answer without considering the other.

questions.stem: Which shape is best for measuring area and why?
choices: Square, because it can be packed tightly without gaps
Triangle, because it can be split into smaller parts
Rectangle, because it is a common shape
questions.solution: The correct answer is Square, because it can be packed tightly without gaps. This allows for accurate measurement of area without leaving spaces between shapes. Circles are not ideal because they leave gaps when packed, triangles can be harder to arrange consistently, and rectangles, while useful, are not as efficient as squares for this specific purpose.

questions.stem: What is the perimeter of a triangle with sides 4 cm, 5 cm, and 7 cm?

questions.stem: If the perimeter of a rectangle is 14 cm and its breadth is 2 cm, what is the length?
questions.solution: The perimeter of a rectangle is 2 × (length + breadth). Given the perimeter is 14 cm and breadth is 2 cm, we have 14 = 2 × (length + 2). Solving, length + 2 = 7, so length = 5 cm. The option '6 cm' is incorrect because it doesn't follow the formula. '7 cm' is the sum of length and breadth. '8 cm' is a random number not derived from the formula.

questions.stem: If the perimeter of a square is 20 cm, what is the length of one side?

questions.stem: If the perimeter of a circle is equal to that of a square, then what is the ratio of their areas?
questions.solution: Let the radius of the circle be r and the side of the square be a. The perimeter of the circle is 2πr, and the perimeter of the square is 4a. If they are equal, then 2πr = 4a, so a = πr/2. The area of the circle is πr², and the area of the square is a² = (πr/2)² = π²r²/4. The ratio of the areas is πr² / (π²r²/4) = 4/π. Using π ≈ 22/7, the ratio becomes 4/(22/7) = 28/22 = 14/11. The option '14:11' is correct. The option '22:7' is incorrect because it is the ratio of the circumference to the diameter, not the areas. The option '7:22' is incorrect because it is the reciprocal of the correct ratio. The option '11:14' is incorrect because it is also the reciprocal of the correct ratio.

hi.stem: यदि एक वृत्त की परिमिति एक वर्ग के समान है, तो उनके क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात क्या है?
hi.solution: मान लीजिए वृत्त की त्रिज्या r है और वर्ग की भुजा a है। वृत्त की परिमिति 2πr है, और वर्ग की परिमिति 4a है। यदि वे समान हैं, तो 2πr = 4a, अतः a = πr/2। वृत्त का क्षेत्रफल πr² है, और वर्ग का क्षेत्रफल a² = (πr/2)² = π²r²/4 है। क्षेत्रफलों का अनुपात πr² / (π²r²/4) = 4/π है। π ≈ 22/7 का उपयोग करके, अनुपात 4/(22/7) = 28/22 = 14/11 हो जाता है। विकल्प '14:11' सही है। विकल्प '22:7' गलत है क्योंकि यह परिधि और व्यास का अनुपात है, न कि क्षेत्रफलों का। विकल्प '7:22' गलत है क्योंकि यह सही अनुपात का व्युत्क्रम है। विकल्प '11:14' गलत है क्योंकि यह भी सही अनुपात का व्युत्क्रम है।

choices: The area of the rectangle is double the area of each triangle
The area of the rectangle is equal to the area of each triangle
The area of the rectangle is half the area of each triangle
The area of the rectangle is unrelated to the area of the triangles
questions.solution: When a rectangle is divided into two triangles by a diagonal, each triangle has half the area of the rectangle because the diagonal splits the rectangle into two equal parts. Therefore, the area of the rectangle is double the area of each triangle. The other options contradict this geometric principle.
